MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Administration Manager



 Apply now
 Job no: 944552

 Work type: Full time

 Location: Adelaide Metro Eastern

 Categories: Administration, Business and Management





 

Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network
 

Rural and Remote Mental Health - Parkside 

Salary: ASO5 $92,122 - $102,456 per annum

Full-Time, Temporary up to 8th January 2028 

WHAT ARE WE OFFERING? 

The Administration Manager provides leadership and coordination of administrative services across the Rural and Remote Mental Health Service, and Barossa Hills Fleurieu Community Mental Health Team (CMHTs), ensuring the delivery of efficient, high-quality day-to-day operations including workforce planning, rostering, recruitment and performance management. It plays a key role in fostering a positive, customer-focused team culture while providing strategic HR and operational support across onboarding, staff development, workforce administration and compliance, and driving ongoing improvement in systems, processes and service delivery.

The position contributes to effective governance and strong business operations through committee coordination, reporting and capital processes, working collaboratively with senior leaders, clinicians and stakeholders to support integrated service delivery. It also supports budget monitoring, operational and workforce planning, funding submissions, quality improvement activities and project work, while assisting with high-quality reporting and responses to enquiries and consumer matters.

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve.

WHERE AND HOW YOU WILL WORK 

Parkside, South Australia is a well-located inner-southern suburb just minutes from Adelaide's CBD, known for its leafy streets, convenient transport options, and easy access to local caf s, parks, and everyday amenities.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 

How do you build effective working relationships and communicate with a wide range of stakeholders across an organisation?

Are you motivated to lead and inspire a high-performing administrative team in a dynamic healthcare environment? 

Do you take pride in delivering efficient, high-quality services while continuously improving systems and processes? 

Are you driven to build strong, collaborative relationships with leaders, clinicians and stakeholders to achieve shared goals? 

Do you thrive on planning, organising and coordinating workforce and operational priorities in a fast-paced setting? 

Are you committed to maintaining high standards of governance, accountability and customer-focused service delivery?

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on. 

HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE? 

You will....

Lead and coordinate the delivery of administrative services across mental health programs 

Oversee workforce planning, rostering, recruitment and performance management 

Manage HR processes including onboarding, staff development and compliance 

Support governance through reporting, committee coordination and business operations 

Contribute to planning, budgeting, quality improvement and project activities

WHAT WILL WE OFFER YOU IN RETURN? 

At BHFLHN, not only will you be working in an environment surrounded by beautiful scenery and nature we see your work here as not just as a job, but an opportunity to extend, progress or consolidate your career with us. We therefore offer you opportunities to be supported in the following ways:

Salary package a range of benefits (including living expenses such as mortgage, rent, utility bills and groceries) up to $9,010 each FBT year + $2,650 for Meal Entertainment expenses each FBT yearClick here more information

Access to generous leave provisions and professional development opportunities.

Support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program.

Health and Fitness Benefits: Access to Fitness Passport, a discounted workplace health and fitness program available to BHFLHN staff and their families.

WHAT ELSE DO YOU NEED TO KNOW-WHAT IS ESSENTIAL FOR SUCCESS? 

Working in this environment, it is important to us that we only employ people with the upmost integrity and commitment to serving the South Australian community and its visitors to the highest possible standards. To ensure that we meet that commitment there are a few checks that you will be required to undertake. These are detailed on the Role Description, but are likely to include the following:

You will need to be immunised. Please contact the Enquiries Person for this position if you have any queries. Addressing vaccine preventable disease: Occupational assessment, screening and vaccination policy.Further information is in the application for to help guide you. 

You will need to undergo employment screening, what you require is also on the front page of the Role Description.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION 

We employ people as diverse as the clients we support and the environments we work in. At BHFLHN we pride ourselves on being an Equal Opportunity employer committed to providing an inclusive workplace that embraces diversity and inclusion for all employees and therefore we encourage applications from people of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander descent, culturally diverse backgrounds, disability, all genders, and LGBTQI+ community. We continually look for ways to support and promote diversity and flexible ways of working so please let us know what interests you. 

NEED TO RELOCATE? 

Relocation financial support may be negotiated, subject to eligibility. See what is available here:Relocation support | SA Health.Find out more about working in theBarossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network, and see what it looks like to work and live in regional Australia at:https:--movetomore.com.au-

HELP IS HERE! 

Please refer to all the details in the Role Description below (job ref: 944552), or reach out to Michelle Howard, Administration Manager, on Phone: 0481 483 606 or via E-mail: michelle.howard@sa.gov.au

To find out what you need to apply, and what is required to be offered a role, please refer to the Applicant ChecklistBHFLHN Applicant Checklist.pdf. Please also click here for ourAustralian applicant guidelines

Stay connected with our Network! Follow us onLinkedInto stay informed about exciting job opportunities and updates on us and what our employees are doing.Click hereto join the conversation.

ARA Marine, formed in 2021 and part of the ARA Group, provides speciality marine safety services technical support and engineering solutions to the commercial shipping, yacht, and offshore maritime industry in 16 major Australian ports. An employee-owned company established in 2001, ARA is comprised of the following operating divisions:

1. ARA Fire & Security 
2. ARA Electrical
3. ARA Property Services
4. ARA Products
5. ARA Marine

We provide customers with a complete range of safety and certified services and requirements. Each company’s products, services, skills and experience complement the other’s to provide clients with the timely service that is required when a ship is in port for only 24 hours

ARA Marine is seeking a talented and experienced Mechanical Engineering Technician to join their team to help support growth. 

Location: 42 Zedora Turn, Henderson, WA 6166
Full time: 38 hours per week
Salary: $95,000 per annum + Superannuation

Key Responsibilities will include:
- Prepare mechanical engineering drawings plan and technical designs under the guidance of Mechanical Engineers and Engineering Technologists
- Assist in the design and development and modification of mechanical equipment and machinery
- Select appropriate tools equipment, and materials for engineering projects and maintenance activities 
- Assemble, install, test and modify mechanical assemblies, components, machine tools, control systems, and hydraulic equipment 
- Estimate material quantities, project costs, and machinery requirements to support project planning and execution
- Conduct and oversee field and laboratory testing to evaluate equipment performance and compliance
- Ensure designs, installations, and completed work comply with engineering specifications, relevant standards, regulations, and contractual requirements
- Support engineering teams by providing technical expertise throughout the design, installation, testing, and maintenance phases of projects. 

Required skills and attributes:
- Strong understanding of mechanical engineering principles and practices
- Ability to read, interpret, and prepare technical drawings, plans and schematics 
- High level of integrity, professionalism, and confidentiality 
- Excellent communication and teamwork skills 
- Min 1 year of experience in a related field
- Associate Degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma in a relevant field  

If you meet the above criteria and you're interested in contributing to an organisation that values the highest level of quality in everything it sets out to achieve, we want to hear from you!

Apply now for this exciting opportunity to be part of the team at ARA Marine!

Job Type: Full-time
Work Location: In person

Skilled Meat Worker
Tibaldi (Aust) Pty Ltd
Clayton, Melbourne VIC
Full time
Salary range: $80,000 - $85,000 

Position Title:		Skilled Meat Worker
Team:				Fresh Meats
Location:			Clayton, Victoria
Reports to:			Boning Room Supervisor
Salary:				$80,000 - $85,000 Per Annum (Excl Superannuation)

Skilled Meat Worker
Join the Tibaldi team as a full-time Skilled Meat Worker based in Clayton, Victoria.

Our Story
Founded in 1934, the Tibaldi family of butchers had a dream to provide Australian’s with only the finest cuts of meats processed the traditional way using authentic Italian recipes.

90 years later not much has changed. Today, Tibaldi are a major supplier to the retail, route and food service industry across Australia. The company’s state of the art facilities in Clayton excel industry standards using leading technology. 

The product range spans across traditional Italian salami, ham, bacon, traditional smallgoods, fresh meat including a range of Outdoor Bred pork.

That’s Tradition. That’s Tibaldi.

Responsibilities and Duties
As a Skilled Meat Worker at Tibaldi you will be part of the Fresh Meats team based in Clayton, Victoria and will be involved in:

•	Using equipment to move carcasses and meat to boning and cutting tables
•	Trim, wash, and clean meat, removing blood, fat, and unwanted material
•	Cut carcasses into standard meat cuts like rumps, shoulders, and flanks
•	Remove internal fat, blood clots, bruises, and other waste materials
•	Operate restrainers and stunning equipment safely
•	Remove heads and head meat where required
•	Perform evisceration and trimming of carcasses

As part of our Fresh Meats team, you will have:

•	AQF Certificate III in Meat Processing
•	Skilled in the humane and efficient slaughter of livestock.
•	Follows strict safety procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.
•	Previous experience for a minimum of 2 years in a meat processing environment
•	The knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards
•	An understanding of humane animal handling
•	The ability to follow detailed procedures and demonstrates clear, effective communication skills.

Our Ways of Working
Our hourly rates of pay are dependent upon your levels of experience.

As part of our Tibaldi team you will be able to:
•	Participate in our Tibaldi Team Product Orders program that enables you to purchase our products at a below-retail price
•	Access free on-site car parking
•	Access our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
•	Participate in training and development courses tailored to your needs; both on-site and off-site
•	Travel to work on public transport as we are conveniently located close to public transport including Westall or Clayton train stations

Pre-Employment Medical
A pre-employment medical will form part of the recruitment process.

External Recruitment
Candidates interested in this position should apply directly to this advertisement as we
are not accepting applications from recruitment agencies at this time.

www.tibaldi.com.au #tibaldi

Northern Interests is a national organisation operating multiple remote roadhouses across South Australia and the Northern Territory. We employ around 130 staff, many of whom live on-site in our staff accommodation.

We’re now seeking an enthusiastic and skilled Cook to join our team at Litchfield Outback Resort.  

As part of our dedicated kitchen team, you’ll help deliver consistently high-quality meals and a welcoming experience for every customer.

The Cook is responsible for preparing, cooking, and presenting meals in accordance with established menus, recipes, and quality standards at the roadhouse. The role supports day-to-day kitchen operations in a high-volume hospitality environment and requires a skilled and reliable individual capable of working independently while maintaining food safety, consistency, and efficiency.

Key responsibilities include:

Preparing, cooking, and presenting menu items in line with recipes and business requirements
Portioning and plating meals consistently
Assisting with preparation of daily or nightly specials as directed by the Head Chef or Site Manager
Monitoring food quality, presentation, and service standards
Operating kitchen equipment and maintaining cleanliness of work areas
Ensuring compliance with food safety, hygiene, and workplace health and safety requirements
Assisting with stock control, storage, and minimising food wastage
Working collaboratively with kitchen and front-of-house staff to ensure efficient service
Any other duties as directed by the Head Chef

This is a hands-on, fast paced role that requires reliability, strong teamwork, and the ability to perform well under pressure while maintaining excellent food presentation and quality.

About You

To be successful, you will have:

A relevant qualification equivalent to an AQF Certificate III in Commercial Cookery (preferred)
Experience working in a commercial kitchen environment
Sound understanding of food safety and hygiene practices
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced team environment

Why Join Us?

This is a unique opportunity to build your career in hospitality while experiencing the lifestyle and community spirit of the Northern Territory. You’ll enjoy a supportive team environment, on-site accommodation, and the chance to make a real impact in our busy, friendly resort.

Don’t miss this opportunity to join a supportive team and experience life in one of Australia’s unique outback locations. To be successful you must have full time, permanent Australian work rights. Given this is a permanent long-term position, working holiday visas will not be accepted.

result.description:
POSITION: RETAIL STORE MANAGER 
EMPLOYMENT TYPE – FULL-TIME Position – Minimum 38 Hours a Week 
Store Location: 60 MAYNE ST MURRURUNDI 2338 NSW
Salary: $70,000 to $80,000 + Superannuation per Annum
Our client Rab Rakha Pty Ltd (Foodworks Murrurundi) in regional NSW is looking for a permanent retail store manager for a long-term position. The store manager position is essential for the business and someone who can manage the day-to-day operations of the store. 
Responsibility:
Responsible for managing the full customer experience by analysing customer needs, promoting product knowledge, and resolving complaints promptly, while building strong relationships with the local community. Maintains accurate sales and financial records, monitors budgets, conversion, profitability and loss, plans in-store promotional events, and ensures compliance with health, hygiene and workplace safety regulations.

Key Duties: 
•	Manage store operations across all the divisions and ensure retail operations are executed efficiently. 
•	Oversee all daily operations including purchasing, stock management and store flow to maintain business efficiency and a high standard.
•	Use data to analyse the needs of customers, ensure customers are provided with excellent service, demonstrate an unwavering focus on customer satisfaction.
•	Resolve customer complaints and issues in a timely and satisfactory manner. 
•	Build strong relationships with the local community to bring value into the business.
•	Promote and explain the products to customers in relation to their usage, dietary and nutritional values.
•	Recruit, interview, train and supervise new staff ensuring every team member is set up for store success objectives, improve service conversion and sales. 
•	Plan and manage rosters around peak trading periods, events, and seasonal demand while staying within staffing budgets.


•	Keep accurate records of sales, POS transactions, financial data and reconcile sales as per company policies. 
•	Ensure budgets and financial objectives are communicated with staff and are met. 
•	Monitor conversion, sales, profitability, loss and advise the business owner accordingly. 
•	Set pricing strategy, liaising with suppliers, monitor stock levels and ensure products lifecycle and returns of damaged goods. 
•	Plan and oversee in-store promotional events or displays. 
•	Ensure all applicable health and hygiene and workplace safety regulations are adhered to.
Minimum Requirements: 
•	Minimum comparable Diploma AQF Level 
•	Minimum 1 year of highly relevant experience in retail store settings as a manager. 

Application opens from 14 July 2026 to 13 August 2026. Kindly apply with detailed cover letter.  Shortlisted candidates who meets the minimum requirements will be contacted for the interview.
result.title: RETAIL STORE MANAGER

result.description:
Farnese Australia Pty Ltd. is seeking a full Time Service Technician to join our team based in Ingleburn NSW.

Reporting to the Services Manager, this is a hands-on, permanent role where you will play a key part in machine installations, preventive and breakdown maintenance. You will work across mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic systems, servicing machinery such as CNC Machine Centres, Bridge Saws, Block Saws, and Jib / Gantry Cranes.
This role offers variety and the opportunity to work both autonomously and within a team. While qualifications are not essential, any mechanical or electrical aptitude will be highly regarded.

Key Responsibilities:
•	Perform preventive and breakdown maintenance of machinery.
•	Install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Install and service equipment, including mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, and hydraulic components.
•	Interpret electrical drawings and perform diagnostic checks.
•	Liaise with clients to understand and address service requirements.

What We Offer:
•	A permanent, full-time role in a supportive team environment.
•	A company vehicle for both work and personal use.
•	Opportunity for hands-on, technical work with diverse, cutting edge equipment.

Essential Criteria
•	Ability to interpret electrical and mechanical concepts and drawings.
•	Ability to install, modify, maintain and repair complex and highly sophisticated electronic instruments and control systems which involve a combination of electrical, electronic and hydraulic and pneumatic principals.
•	Previous experience in machinery preventive maintenance.
•	Strong mechanical aptitude and fault-finding skills.
•	Excellent communication and client liaison skills.
•	Reliable work ethic with attention to detail and accuracy.
•	Ability to work independently or as part of a team.
•	Current driver's licence.
•	Minimum of less than 1 year of machinery preventive maintenance experience required.
•	Ability to interpret basic electrical symbols and drawings required.

Desirable Criteria:
•	Electrical fault-finding experience.
•	Knowledge of electrical control systems.
•	Experience with CNC machine technology and operation.
•	Background in the stone industry, manufacturing, or machinery service.

Renumeration: $85,000 - $105,000 + Super for the right candidate.

If you are looking for a hands-on, technically challenging role with the potential to grow and expand your skill set, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now and become an integral part of our team at Farnese Australia.

result.description:
Hospitality Management

CH on Peel Pty Ltd is looking for another full-time member for its management team. Situated in the heart of Tamworth, our operations include the 62 room CH Boutique Hotel, the heritage listed DECO Wine Bar & Restaurant, Hopscotch Restaurant, the Pavilion Function & Conference Centre, Pig & Tinder Box Restaurant & Bar, The Bureau, and the Dungowan Brewery. All our restaurants are full service dine in establishments.

The Position

You will have an opportunity to further develop your hospitality skills and experience work in a variety of areas across our food service sites. The position includes managerial level food and beverage duties and bar work. This position is suited for candidates that like to work in a fast-paced supportive team environment, with high quality table service experience preferred. The successful applicant must be available across a 7 day roster including nights and weekends.

As a member of our management team, you will be responsible for the overall running of the business from top to bottom, leading by example and maintaining high standards. You must be highly motivated and able to manage all operational elements of the business from front to back of house. You will be passionate about your job, have a superior knowledge of food and beverage, understand the order of service and ensure our clients leave having had an all-round unforgettable dining experience.

Key Duties

* Delivering exceptional Customer Service
* Maintaining the service area
* Knowledge of Food Safety requirements
* Understanding of liquor licensing laws and compliance
* Proven record managing restaurants and meeting KPI targets
* Proven financial management capabilities
* Arranging bespoke events
* Experience in training staff with cultural sensitivity
* Working with our chefs to update and improve menus
* Overseeing of rostering
* Selecting and training restaurant and service staff
* Stock level management
* Cash handling and register operation

The Person

* RSA Certificate Essential
* Diploma in Hospitality Operations or Similar desirable
* Previous Bar experience
* Be able to work independently
* Experience in a fast-paced hospitality environment
* Great presentation and customer service skills
* Willingness to be part of an enthusiastic and motivated team
* Willingness to jump into any task required, cleaning, food preparation and customer service
* Strong awareness of Hygiene & Food Safety Standards
* Must always be well presented, have a great work ethic and the ability to perform well under pressure
* A Positive can-do attitude and the ability to work nights & weekends

So, if you are a 'can-do' person, who thrives on new challenges; likes working in a team environment; and consistently delivers to the highest quality, then you'll fit right in and we'd like to have you on our team.

Salary package: $63,000 - $73,000 per annum plus Super depending on skills and experience
